lede: Connect storage you have elsewhere, then open it as a folder on this computer.
where: Keys, passwords and tokens you enter go only to this computer's files program, once, and are kept there in a private file. The Hub never keeps them.
notRunning: Start the computer to see or change its storage.
noAddress: This computer's files program has no address yet.
noWrite: Only people who can change this computer can add, open, close or remove storage.
pick.none: No storage of that name. Try another word.
f.endpoint.help: Needed for services other than Amazon.
f.key_pem.help: Paste the whole key. It is sent once and cleared from this form.
f.address.creds: Leave the password or token out of the address and put it in its own field.
f.oneOf: Enter a password or a private key.
f.token.help: Paste the token from the steps above. It is sent once and cleared from this form.
f.token.bad: That doesn't look like an rclone token. Paste the whole token, curly brackets included. If it was split across lines, join it into one line.
f.client_id.help: Use the same client ID and secret you gave rclone.
f.client_id.bad: A client ID starts with a letter or number and has only letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.
f.client_id.needs: Enter the client secret that goes with this client ID.
f.client_secret.needs: Enter the client ID that goes with this secret.
f.team_drive.help: Leave empty to use My Drive.
f.root_folder_id.help: Leave empty to start at the top.
f.hostname.help: Choose eapi.pcloud.com if your pCloud account is in Europe.
token.title: Get a token with rclone
token.step.run: Run the command below and sign in in the browser it opens
token.step.paste: Paste everything it prints into Token
token.ownClient: With your own client ID, the command also takes the ID and your secret, in that order.
token.retiring: rclone's shared Google sign-in app is being retired and may stop working.
token.retiring.fix: Setting up your own client ID with Google is recommended; rclone's Google Drive documentation explains how.
token.od.why: OneDrive also needs its drive, so its token comes from an rclone config.
token.od.show.note: Copy its token, drive_id and drive_type into the fields below.
token.od.delete.note: So the token isn't left on your computer.
token.box: This storage can be opened as a plain folder only.
connect.lede: This computer checks the details with the storage before it keeps them.
connect.nothingSent: Nothing is sent until you press Connect.
connect.failed: The storage did not accept these details, or this computer could not reach it. Check them and try again.
backends.title: Connected storage
row.name: {{user}} on {{provider}}
row.removeBlocked: Close its folder first, then remove it.
mount.title: Open {{name}} as a folder
mount.lede: This computer gets a new folder that shows what is on the storage.
mount.label: Folder name
mount.labelHelp: Shown in the list. Each folder on this computer needs its own name.
unmount.title: Close the folder {{name}}?
unmount.body: The folder {{path}} goes away from this computer. What is on the storage stays. Files written to the folder that are not uploaded yet stay on this computer.
remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: This computer forgets the keys for {{name}}. Nothing on the storage itself is deleted. If a folder of it was opened elsewhere in the meantime, it closes too, and files not uploaded yet stay on this computer.
remove.unread: The lists could not be read again just now, so nothing was removed. Try again in a moment.
remove.partial: It was not removed: one of its folders was opened elsewhere just now. Some of its other folders may have closed; the lists show where it stands.
held.connect: Connecting {{name}} may already have gone through. The list can't tell this one apart from other storage of the same kind, so look for it under Connected storage.
held.mount: The folder {{name}} may already have been opened. Check again before trying again.
held.unmount: The folder {{name}} may already have been closed. Check again before trying again.
held.remove: {{name}} may already have been removed. Check again before trying again.
held.dismissBody: Stop tracking only if you know it did not go through. If it did, sending again makes a second one.
held.dismissBodyConnect: This page can't tell whether this connect went through: a new or changed entry under Connected storage could come from another connect, and Test checks only the details stored now. Stop tracking lets you go on while the outcome stays unknown. Connecting again may update the existing entry or add another, depending on the details; if you end up with two, remove the one you don't need.
held.dismissBodyToken: This page can't tell whether this connect went through: a new {{name}} entry could come from another connect. Stop tracking lets you go on while the outcome stays unknown. Connecting again may update the existing entry or add another, depending on the token; if you end up with two, remove the one you don't need.
held.elsewhere: It was sent from another tab or page, so only that one can stop tracking it.
write.sent: Sent to the computer, syncing to {{name}}
write.held: Not synced: held on the computer
pu.title: Waiting to upload
pu.lede: Files written to a storage folder that have not reached the storage yet, to deliver, download or discard.
pu.noStorage: Storage that is no longer connected
pu.reason.unconfirmed_at_stop: the folder closed before it was confirmed
pu.reason.changed_on_storage: it changed in the storage meanwhile
pu.reason.check_failed: the storage could not be checked
pu.reason.cannot_verify: the storage can't show whether it changed
pu.incomplete: {{n}} may be incomplete: they can be downloaded or discarded, not delivered.
pu.lastFailed: The last delivery stopped before it finished.
pu.deliver.title: Deliver to the storage?
pu.deliver.body: Every complete file goes to the storage and replaces the copy there, even one changed since. Incomplete files stay here.
pu.stop.title: Stop uploading?
pu.stop.body: Files not sent yet stay on this computer, to deliver, download or discard later. A file still open in a program stops working.
pu.stop.done: Stopped. The files not sent yet are held here.
pu.discard.title: Discard the files of {{name}}?
pu.discard.c1: They are deleted from this computer and never reach the storage.
pu.discard.c2: They may be the only copy of these changes. This can't be undone.
pu.held.deliver: A delivery of {{name}} may have gone through.
pu.held.stop: Stopping {{name}}… The computer hasn't confirmed it yet.
pu.held.discard: A discard of {{name}} may have gone through.
pu.gone: No longer held on the computer. Check {{storage}} for it.
pu.files.title: Files of {{name}}
pu.files.s.all: These files are on this computer and have not reached the storage yet.
pu.files.s.some: These files have not reached the storage yet, and
pu.files.inexact: Its name has characters this page can't show exactly.
pu.files.failed: The download did not finish. Nothing was saved.
pu.files.error: The files could not be read.
pu.files.partial: Couldn't read all of this list, so some files may be missing.
notRunning.title: The computer is stopped
noAddress.title: No address yet
why.unread: Waits for the lists to be read whole.
why.busy: Another change here is still going.
works.label: Works with {{list}} and {{count}} more
glance.title: At a glance
pu.col.name: Folder
